title: Microbial Physiology & Metabolic Pathways
institution: SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce (Empowered Autonomous), Sion
description: Exploration of bacterial growth kinetics, continuous and batch culture systems, energetic pathways (glycolysis, TCA, electron transport chains), membrane transport mechanisms, and metabolic regulation in response to environmental stressors.

title: Environmental Microbiology & Waste Valorization
institution: SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce, Sion
description: Applied study of microbial communities in soil, water, and air. Emphasis on organic waste conversion, anaerobic ensilage fermentation, microbial consortium dynamics, bioremediation of xenobiotics, and bio-fertilizer production.
keyTopics: Solid Waste Degradation & Temple Flower Ensilage
pedagogyTool: Field Sampling, Temple Waste Collection & Live Silage Protocols

title: Applied Industrial Microbiology & Fermentation
institution: SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce, Sion
description: Industrial upstream and downstream processing, bioreactor design, media optimization using agricultural by-products, aeration and agitation controls, and product recovery of pigments, enzymes, and organic acids.
keyTopics: Natural Media Formulations from Organic Waste
pedagogyTool: Interactive Virtual Lab Simulations & Troubleshooting Scenarios

title: B.Sc. Semester II Major Microbiology Laboratory Practicals
institution: SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce, Sion
description: Hands-on fundamental laboratory practicals aligned with the co-authored practical manual. Students master aseptic transfer, differential Gram and endospore staining, pure culture isolation, serial dilutions, and enzyme kinetics.
keyTopics: Pour Plate, Spread Plate & Streak Plate Techniques
pedagogyTool: Pre-Lab Inquiries & Co-Authored Practical Manual (My Rays Publishing House)
